Name: flairconny's krobus portraits and sprites
Author: flairconny
Description:
it's almost sad how little there are portraits of **the** scrunkly, so i decided to make some that (in my opinion) lean into suiting his character a bit more

by character i mean a thousand yard stare, avoiding eye contact, and overall looking a little awkward(okay maybe that's not really something apparent enough to label as his character BUT IT'S MY OPINION AND I'M NOT SORRY BARK BARK BARK WOOF WOOF WOOF)



!!sprites now available!!
(speaking of, i can't thank you all enough for the support in the comments
you guys really are something else )


to install both sprites and portraits, just download the standalone file and drop it into your [u]mod folder[/u] along with content patcher by pathoschild

but if it's just the portraits that you're after, you'll need portraiture by platonymous. download the according file and drop it into [u]mod folder > portraiture > portraits[/u] and it should work

thanks for checking it out <3

Downloads.Description: that one's for portraiture(idk what else to say srry)

a standalone file for those who want both portraits and sprites



again, to get this to work you just need to drop it into your mod folder
